elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code defining a custom PDF class using the fpdf library to create an executive summary report. The code includes class PDF inheriting from FPDF, methods for header, chapter_title, chapter_body, and a function create_executive_summary that generates a PDF with a title and sections. The code snippet shows setting margins, fonts, adding pages, and outputting the PDF file named 'executive_summary.pdf'.
elements.summary: This code example demonstrates how to programmatically create an executive summary report in Python using the fpdf library.
